data.revised_prompt:
Create a single horizontal 4-frame sprite strip for a Codex app digital pet named "tracebun" in the waving animation, using the provided base pet/reference as the exact identity lock. Preserve the same bunny character design, warm brown and cream palette, thick dark outline, compact chibi proportions, floppy ears, calm focused eyes, small service badge on the chest, tiny engineer/guardian vibe, and overall silhouette. Only change the pose/action for waving; keep identity consistent across all 4 frames.

Canvas and background requirements: the entire canvas must be a perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF edge to edge. Absolutely no white, off-white, gray, checkerboard, border, guide, frame, slot lines, labels, or background texture anywhere. Do not include any layout guide elements from the reference.

Layout: 4 separate animation frames arranged left-to-right in one row, evenly spaced, each frame fully contained in its own slot area but with no visible slot dividers. Keep one complete pose per frame with no cropping and no crossing into adjacent frames. Center the character in each frame with safe padding. The sprite strip should read as a readable waving cycle, subtle and cute.

Animation direction: create distinct waving poses across the 4 frames. Keep the body mostly steady, with small pose changes only: one paw lifts to wave, then slightly higher/nearer the face, then a friendly small wave peak, then return toward rest. Maintain the same face, badge, ears, body proportions, and accessories. Do not redesign or mutate the character.

Style: pixel-art sprite sheet look, clean edges, readable at small size, simple shading, consistent outline weight, no extra props, no effects, no text.
